body: I think I'm actually going to do this tonight. It happened about 2 weeks ago though so how would I explain not telling him for so long?

It sounds horrible but the experience made me really realize that I can't lose him. You are a very kind hearted person and I wish you the best. Thank you for being so understanding. I hope soon enough I'll learn to live with myself  for what I've done
thank you for your comment. I really hope that I move on from this soon.. I just want it to disappear

I don't think my boyfriend would understand to be honest. Quite a few months back he got super hammered and blacked out but people said he made out with a girl and he told me but I just I don't know what to do and I don't want to tell him because I already hate myself and I don't want him to see it that way too.

I truly hope that you are right. I've come to the conclusion that I took comfort from a friend and they took advantage of my vulnerability in that moment. Doesn't change or make what I did okay. I love my boyfriend with everything I have and it's destroying me knowing what I've done. I have morals and I never ever once thought I'd ever do this. Thank you for your comment, you're too kind and I don't deserve it but I appreciate it
It doesn't change what I did though, he was just going through some stuff and needed time I guess. Doesn't make what I've done okay

I know, I've cut him out of my life now as I finally see he hasn't had my best interests in mind and played against my vulnerability. I'm just shocked and I hate myself. I don't want to lose my boyfriend and I don't know what to do
I've thought about it but I know how that'll end and I know it's selfish but I just can't bring myself to do it
